notes: MOTHER CORRECTION (research 2026-07-04, resolving Martha Taber Hedger's parent-too-young flag): this Thomas Cheesman -- b. 11 May 1734, d. 9 Feb 1792, Waterford, Gloucester Co. NJ -- is independently documented on WikiTree (Cheesman-113), with an exact match on both dates, as the son of Peter Cheesman and his SECOND wife, Ann Hanna (Ellis) Cheesman (b. 16 Apr 1710 England, d. 1759 Gloucester NJ; her own WikiTree profile Ellis-4456 lists Thomas as her son, cross-consistent with Cheesman-113), NOT of Martha Taber Hedger. Thomas's documented wife was Maribeth (Hedger) Cheeseman (m. 27 May 1771) -- coincidentally a daughter of Martha Taber (by her own first husband, Joseph Hedger), making Martha Thomas's step-mother-in-law rather than his mother. Machine-owned parents array left unedited per repo convention; see docs/research/ancestors/gen09-martha-taber-hedger-eliza-bolton-taber.md and I182195863485.json (Peter Cheesman) manual.notes for full sourcing.
